summary: Maps channels from one or more input TOPs, constants, or luminance into the output RGBA channels.

key_params.name: outputred
key_params.note: Source input or constant for output red.

key_params.name: outputredchan
key_params.note: Channel selected from the red source.

key_params.name: outputgreen
key_params.note: Source input or constant for output green.

key_params.name: outputgreenchan
key_params.note: Channel selected from the green source.

key_params.name: outputblue
key_params.note: Source input or constant for output blue.

key_params.name: outputbluechan
key_params.note: Channel selected from the blue source.

key_params.name: outputalpha
key_params.note: Source input or constant for output alpha.

key_params.name: outputalphachan

common_gotchas: This is a multi-input TOP; output channels can come from different inputs.
Use constants or luminance intentionally when building masks, alpha channels, or packed data.
Reorder changes channel wiring only; it does not do color-space conversion.
Common TOP channel mask and format can change what downstream operators see.
Official labels contain the typo Ouput for several output channel controls; keep ids, not labels, authoritative.
key_concepts: Routes output RGBA channels from one or more input TOPs.
Each output channel can choose its source input and source channel independently.
Constants, zero, one, and luminance can be used as channel sources.
Supports 3D textures and 2D texture arrays while preserving channel-routing semantics.
